test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: JR 11 is related to KT 16 in a certain way. In the same way, VM 22 is related to WO 27. To which of the following is DS 18 related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Last number **⇒ (5) is added

So,

 
• JR 11 is related to KT 16​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/051808929b532ed615a6f55f79a25b9b1c365a9e7fee024c50af862873762318.png] 

And,

 
• VM 22 is related to WO 27

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69cf78e7cf57f7750a3818e8d01cffa706b1eb68d768942c00326b39150aac45.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• DS 18 is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a411211a623293fac7d2788a17e33c66691cf49619610022ac4508e00c194b5b.png] 

​Hence, "**EU 23**" is the correct answer.
